canonical_name: Incremental settlement feasibility and cabin fallback

mechanism.old_value_source: stored per-passenger prices of all currently reserved flights
mechanism.candidate_value_source: current per-passenger fares of the complete candidate itinerary
mechanism.decision_rule: test cabin choices in the user's stated preference order and select the first whose incremental charge is within the authorized limit
mechanism.correct_path: read the reservation and candidates, compute each complete-replacement settlement delta from stored prices, select the first feasible cabin, confirm, and perform one flight update
mechanism.competing_path: compare gross candidate fare or total historical payment with the limit, producing the wrong fallback or no-mutation decision

trigger_inputs.required_relation: preferred-cabin gross fare exceeds the limit while its incremental charge is within the limit
preferred-cabin incremental charge exceeds the limit; fallback-cabin gross fare exceeds the limit but its incremental charge is within the limit

excluded_dimensions: partially preserved itinerary or preserved-segment repricing
baggage allowance, baggage count, or baggage fee as a decision branch

agent_reads: user cabin preference order and incremental-charge limit

success_checks: reservation flights exactly match the expected complete candidate itinerary
selected cabin matches the settlement-feasible branch
passengers and unrelated reservations are unchanged
no unrequested baggage or payment mutation occurs
evaluator.failure_attribution: wrong cabin or omitted update caused by gross-fare rather than stored-baseline delta planning
evaluator.governance_evaluation: existing unified Airline Governance evaluator remains unchanged
